overview_description.description: At Community Phone, we provide simple, reliable phone service for both homes and businesses. Our service doesn’t require the internet and continues to work during power outages. It’s powered by the Community Phone base, a device that connects your phone directly to cell towers in your area. Just plug it in, connect your phone and enjoy unlimited local and long-distance calls across the U.S.

about_short_description.short_description: Community Phone provides easy-to-use, dependable landline phone service for households and businesses.

product.name: Community Phone Landline Service
product.description: A wireless landline phone service that operates without internet or traditional phone wiring, providing nationwide coverage and backup power during outages.

product.name: Community Phone Business Phone System
product.description: A plug-and-play business phone system with mobile app integration, shared phone lines, call routing, and call forwarding features.

identifier.value: Community Phone Mobile and Desktop App

product.name: Community Phone Mobile and Desktop App
product.description: An application that allows users to make and receive calls, access voicemail, and manage shared phone lines from mobile devices or desktop computers.

product.name: Spam and Scam Call Blocking
product.description: A built-in system that automatically filters and blocks up to 99% of robocalls, AI scams, and telemarketers without user setup.

product.name: Advanced Call Management Features
product.description: Features including call forwarding, call routing, shared numbers, simultaneous ringing, and missed call auto-text to improve call handling and communication efficiency.
